tasks.label: Start Backend
tasks.command: bash -l -c 'if lsof -i:8080 > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Backend already running on port 8080"; else cd /workspaces/bit-semester-planner && ./mvnw spring-boot:run -DskipTests; fi'

tasks.label: Wait for Backend
tasks.command: bash -c 'echo "Waiting for backend on port 8080..."; until (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/8080) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done; echo "Backend is up!"'

tasks.label: Start Frontend
tasks.command: bash -l -c 'if lsof -i:5173 > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Frontend already running on port 5173"; else cd /workspaces/bit-semester-planner/frontend && npm run dev; fi'
